surface.basis: Pirelli 2026 Bahrain GP in Malaysia preview (the 2026 infographic): asphalt grip 2/5, asphalt abrasion 4/5. Other ratings, not used here: traction 3, braking 4, lateral 4, tyre stress 4, track evolution 4.

source.notes: TUM centreline scaled to 5,543 m; widths normalised to the operator's 16-22 m. Heights: SRTM 30 m (public domain) through Open Topo Data, sampled every 20 m along my-1999 from bacinger/f1-circuits, lined up by curvature and smoothed over about 200 m.
